text: さいきん　ポケモンセンターの　２かいの　ダイレクト　コーナーで　きのみを　つぶす　きかいを　おいて　もらったのじゃ　……そこで！

structure.jp: ポケモンセンターの　２かいの　ダイレクト　コーナーで
structure.en: at the Direct Corner on the Pokémon Center's second floor

structure.jp: きのみを　つぶす　きかいを　おいて　もらったのじゃ
structure.en: I had them put in a machine that crushes Berries, you see

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: もらう after a て-form verb says you get someone to do the thing for you. おいて　もらった = 'I had them put it there for me'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きのみを　つぶす　きかい
patterns.explanation: The phrase before きかい describes it: it tells what the machine does. きのみを　つぶす　きかい = 'a machine that crushes Berries'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. のじゃ is the old-man form of it. おいて　もらったのじゃ = 'I had it put there, you see'.
